$format.about: One entry per system type, from the Master Template: the SHAPE of a block only (header form, line order, wording form per slot, tech-hour rule). Never content: no default lines, no device a block gets without this job's evidence. Read by src/bms/playbook.py, which rejects a malformed file.
$format.shapes: A list of shape entries. Names are unique.

entry.name: The shape name (System.shape refers to it), e.g. "Exhaust Fan".

applies_to.prefixes: Tag prefixes that pick this shape (upper case, no dash), e.g. ["EF", "GEF"].
applies_to.kind_words: Words in a family or system name that pick this shape when no prefix does, lower case, e.g. ["exhaust fan"].

entry.header: The block header form. Placeholders: {n} the printed count (or ## when unknown), {name} the system name, {tags} the tags as printed (a range when consecutive).
entry.family_names: The family names this shape's blocks carry, in print order (a VRF block: indoor, condensing, branch selector).
entry.line_order: Every slot name, in print order. A device's slot must be one of these.
entry.slot_kinds: Per slot: "device" (hardware AME or another party furnishes), "point" (a control point / signal on equipment), "interlock" (a tie to another system, no verb), "integration" (the integration trio's lines), "wiring" (wiring only). Every slot in line_order has a kind.
entry.wording: Per slot: the house phrase form. Placeholders: {verb} the device's verb, {device} the device's name in the document's words, {owner} the owner bracket from wording.json (empty when AME furnishes), {qty} the quantity form from wording.json (empty when the block count applies), {what} the equipment named in an integration line. Every slot in line_order has a wording.
entry.order: The block order in the scope: lower prints first, the plan's own order kept within one number. 0: Global Points (first in the scope, before the equipment); 10: the front end and equipment blocks; a block whose count prints Qty (##) (a system named only in the sequence) prints after every block of order 10 or less, at order 20. Exceptions and the fixed text are not blocks and keep their places.
entry.under: Optional. Per sub-line slot: the parent slot it prints under, e.g. {"sensor": "panel"}. A sub-line slot's wording has no {verb}: its device prints one level in, directly after its parent's line, and takes the parent's verb and ownership; the block needs a device in the parent slot. The parent comes earlier in line_order. Set where the Master Template printed the line as a sub-line (assets/system_templates.json depth 2).

tech_hours.per: What the hours count per: one of unit, hardware_point, indoor_unit, panel, fan, fixed, line.
tech_hours.hours: Hours per item, or null when the rule gives none unless a condition below holds.
tech_hours.when: A list of {"if": [slot names], "hours": number}: these hours apply when the block has a device in every slot named.

conventions.source: Workstream 1, 2026-10-04: one entry per Master Template system type (assets/system_templates.json), shape only, plus four shapes the estimator's practice rules need and the template lacks (Motorized Dampers, Duct Heater, Integrated Equipment, Front End). The mapping is in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-04-playbook-sources.md.
conventions.order: File order decides shape_for: more specific kind words come before general ones (Toilet Exhaust Fan before Exhaust Fan), and a group whose prefixes overlap another's keeps only its distinctive prefixes (Geothermal: GHP, GWP, HGP).
conventions.slots: A slot is a place a line prints if, and only if, this job's documents put a device there. Several devices may share a slot (one line per distinct damper type, valve or sensor); they print in the order the devices are listed.
conventions.other_slots: other_device, other_point, fire_alarm, other_valve, other_install_and_wire, other_wire, other_interlock, other_wiring: where a line beyond the template's own slots prints, in the GEM's standard order, before the integration lines. Fire / Smoke Dampers has none (that block holds only its interlock wiring and end-switch status).
conventions.integration_slots: comm_wiring, map_points, rep_assist: the factory-controls trio; vfd_comm_wiring, vfd_map_points, vfd_rep_assist: the VFD trio, before the factory trio when both apply (GEM), except where the template itself orders a plant's groups. The comm_wiring device is named 'BMS Communication Wiring to <equipment> Factory Controls' (or 'to <equipment> VFD Controls'); map and rep lines print their house text as written.
conventions.sub_lines: Every wording without {verb} is either a sub-line ("under" names its parent: gas detection sensors and horn / strobes under the panel, the HVAC alarm list under its heading, unit ventilator terminal-strip devices under the tie-in line, Misc Monitoring details under their monitored item and meter wiring under its meter, every rep-assist line under its Map Available Points line) or house text that carries its own verb (Interlock, Tie-in, Map, Monitor, wiring phrases, a plain work statement in other_wiring). Misc Monitoring monitored items and the Refrigeration Monitoring horn / strobe, pull station and remote sensor print at the first level with no verb, as the Master Template prints them.
conventions.fixed_wording: A wording with no {device} prints its house text as written whenever a device is in that slot (the device still carries its citation and ownership).
